en: Vintage sepia postcard showing several chalet-style spa buildings nestled in a conifer forest on a hillside, with two people walking on a path in the foreground. The back reads "REPUBLICA POPULARĂ ROMÂNĂ" and identifies the place as Borsec — Casa de odihnă C.G.M., with publisher "LIBRARIA NOASTRĂ." It bears Romanian People's Republic stamps and Bucharest postmarks with 1950s dates, plus a handwritten address.
